projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The sustained high device count (23-27) paired with zero camera activity for over four hours on a Monday morning strongly indicates a camera system outage, privacy mode, or that presence is driven entirely by stationary IoT devices rather than people, warranting a quick system status check.

The consistent presence of 21-25 devices confirms the household is still home, but the complete lack of camera activity during typical Monday morning hours strongly suggests a camera system outage rather than an empty house. This matters because it leaves the home unmonitored during peak daytime hours.

The consistent presence of 21-25 mobile devices from 08:11 to 09:29, combined with zero camera activity, indicates the household has not yet departed for school or work, deviating from the typical Monday morning routine. This suggests a late start or everyone staying home, which may require adjusting routine notifications or security status.

The steady decline in connected mobile devices from 08:18 to 08:27, combined with zero camera activity, confirms a quiet, staggered household departure likely via the garage or side exit, as devices transition from home Wi-Fi to cellular networks. This indicates the home is now fully empty and aligns with typical Monday routines.

The drop in connected devices from 27 to 26 at 07:30 aligns with a typical Monday morning departure, likely indicating a child heading to school. The lack of camera triggers suggests a quiet exit, but no security concerns are indicated.

The stable presence of 25–26 devices combined with zero camera motion and active sleep tracking confirms the entire household is deeply asleep and settled, ruling out sensor failure, wandering pets, or unauthorized activity.
Roxanne slept only 3.16h last night. May be a rough morning — heads up.

The sustained presence of 25–27 devices combined with zero camera motion over four hours indicates a large gathering is taking place in an unmonitored area or guests are keeping a low profile. This matters because it confirms a social event is underway while highlighting a monitoring blind spot during peak evening hours.

The sustained 23–26 connected devices paired with zero camera motion over four hours strongly suggests a large, seated gathering in camera-blind areas (like a backyard or garage), or indicates the cameras may be offline or misconfigured. Verify camera functionality and confirm the event is expected.

The sustained count of 23–27 connected devices paired with zero camera motion over four hours strongly indicates the presence system is counting smart home IoT gadgets, guest Wi-Fi, or a network artifact rather than actual people, suggesting a false positive that warrants a quick network configuration check.
